technicalChecks.audio: optional original procedural draft, 48kHz stereo, no clipping in PCM source; no subjective listening claim

playbackCheck: The reviewed draft played to the end at 1x in a browser: 600 frames, zero reported drops, no media error. Visual observations came from extracted frames; this is not a claim of frame-by-frame viewing or hearing the soundtrack.
improvements: Shared geometry and color connect the phases; objects move and reconfigure instead of only changing text in fixed panels.
120 credits stay valid until the expiry event, then the value changes directly to zero.
The choosing-a-plan phase is labeled separately; task icons do not represent restored expired credits.
The task stages expand into full-width compositions, then return to the opening visual arrangement for the conclusion.
remainingLimits: The study is a deliberately authored 20-second project, not a generic planner or an automatic motion primitive API.
Large headings and geometric arrays remain dominant; richer visual storytelling and art direction still need further iteration.
The price phase explains a shared comparison unit; without actual quotes it does not demonstrate a real price difference.
Subjective beauty, pacing and sound quality need human acceptance. Passing code and playback checks is insufficient.
reviewRepair: Replaced multiplication signs between usage, unit price and capacity with separators to avoid implying an invalid formula.
